in_sanskrit.name: Shekhawat
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler of the desert
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shekhawat एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A person who rules over a desert or a region with vast sandy wasteland. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shekha' meaning desert and 'Wat' meaning to rule.

in_tamil.name: Shekhawat
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Ruler of the desert
in_tamil.long_meaning: Shekhawat ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। A person who rules over a desert or a region with vast sandy wasteland. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shekha' meaning desert and 'Wat' meaning to rule.

in_telugu.name: Shekhawat
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Ruler of the desert
in_telugu.long_meaning: Shekhawat ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। A person who rules over a desert or a region with vast sandy wasteland. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shekha' meaning desert and 'Wat' meaning to rule.

in_marathi.name: Shekhawat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the desert
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shekhawat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A person who rules over a desert or a region with vast sandy wasteland. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shekha' meaning desert and 'Wat' meaning to rule.

in_bengali.name: Shekhawat
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Ruler of the desert
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shekhawat একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A person who rules over a desert or a region with vast sandy wasteland. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shekha' meaning desert and 'Wat' meaning to rule.
